notes.title: Update to Version 0.11
notes.content: Added Co-Op adventure mode teaser, as well as several fixes in calibration and visual updates. Also keeping versions in-line with Meta Quest version.

notes.title: Additional BugFixes
notes.content: Added a couple more fixes to ensure a smoother transition between matches.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Ease of Use
notes.content:
Fixed several things that weren't reset properly at the end of a match.

Also added several features to allow the host to manage the game better, making a better first-time experience for new players.

notes.title: Accessibility Updates
notes.content:
Added an option to disable turret rotation for those who get motion sick easily.
Added option to place a mounted shield to your body for one-handed gameplay.
